column1: # RFC-0191 P0.1 — product-guarantee freeze (D1/R1/T1/C1).
# Columns (whitespace-separated): id  layer  catalog_id  theorem  lean_file  entry
#   id          D1 | R1 | T1 | C1 — exactly these four, one each.
#   layer       model | atom | close — only moves UP. Descending a row
#               so that atom|close count falls below floor_promoted = red.
#   catalog_id  `catalog:<id>` must resolve in scripts/formal/catalog.json.
#   theorem     atom/close: must exist as `theorem <name>` in lean_file,
#               statement carries a forall-binder, file has zero `sorry`.
#               model rows use `-` (no close credit).
#   lean_file   path or `-` on model rows.
#   entry       the rustc-linked kernel fn the row is about.
# floor_promoted N pins the minimum number of atom|close rows. Freeze
# day-1: R1=atom (visible_at_deletion_never_live), D1/T1/C1=model → N=1.
# P1.2: D1=close (`d1_wal_commit_plan` ∀ Bool×Bool of wal_commit_plan) → N=2.
# P1.3: T1=atom (`t1_leftover_fate` ∀ committed of leftover_fate) → N=3.
# P1.4: C1=close (`c1_joint_election` ∀ counts+Option of joint_election_ok
# against the pure majority spec `maj`) → N=4.
# Depth-floor close stays 1 pair (merge_sift): registering an already-
# extracted pair as close would drop proof_depth.extract below floor 276.
floor_promoted 4
D1
R1
T1
C1
